newsitem.title: USA: Sportmart focusing on specialty areas.
newsitem.headline: Sportmart focusing on specialty areas.

text.p: Sportmart Inc said Wednesday it is continuing to move toward a new merchandising strategy, implementing four specialized product areas.

Sportmart said its Lombard, Illinois, prototype store opened in mid-October, with four specialty areas or "worlds" -- team sports, footwear, fitness and outdoor lifestyle. Most Sportmart stores carry general sports merchandise.

"Within each world, we will allocate floor space and inventory dollars to better reflect the consumer's interest and maximize sales per square foot," Andrew Hochberg, chief executive of Sportmart, said in a statement.
"We believe our 'Four Worlds' strategy positively differentiates us from our competitors and gives us an opportunity to maximize sales in our most profitable businesses," Hochberg said.
Sportmart on Wednesday reported a third quarter operating loss of $0.16 a share versus a loss of $0.13 last year.
Sportmart said it operates 70 stores compared with 63 at the end of the third quarter last year.
